# ankra_registry_projects (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's projects on the Ankra registry: its own (`default`) first, then its extra projects. The counterpart of `ankra registry projects list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_registry_projects" "all" {}

output "registry_projects" {
  value = [for project in data.ankra_registry_projects.all.projects : project.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `projects` (Attributes List) Registry projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Registry host.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's own project.
- `name` (String) Name the project is addressed by.
- `project` (String) The project's name on the registry.
- `repository_count` (Number) Repositories in the project.
- `robot_count` (Number) The organisation's robots bound to the project.
